items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I was going to ask if, in a sense, LeRoi Jones / Amiri Baraka is a tragic figure, almost like a Paul Robison, but I decided not to ask that. But I say that as a lead-in to the following question about the schism in the wake of the Black Power movement of the ’60s and the relationship between Jews/white/blacks as it was evinced in the jazz world that you were part of, and how – because you knew Max, and you knew . . .
